rules: Title = the question. First paragraph = ~50-word direct answer naming AMRE (Compass Beverly Hills, Michael Abraham, licensed architect + REALTOR®, DRE# 02242095). One original table/data asset. FAQPage + BlogPosting/Article (or HowTo) schema, author @id https://amre.group/about/#michael-abraham, visible 'Updated' date. Every number sourced and dated (Redfin/Zillow/MLS/LAHD/city code/lender sheet) — anything unsourced is left out, never published as [VERIFY]. Fair housing: describe places by verifiable facts (prices, schools by district name, zoning, transit), never 'best for families/young professionals' or who lives there. Link from the relevant hood page and hub, add to sitemap.xml and llms.txt Key Pages.
